caption: The drawing depicts an elaborate dress with a full skirt and fitted bodice, shown from the front and back. The front view is detailed and colored, showing the dress primarily in a dark, muted brownish or purplish tone, covered with a pattern of yellowish-orange and green floral designs distributed evenly across the fabric. The dress features long sleeves, which open widely at the elbows and are trimmed with white lace at the cuffs. The bodice is closely fitted and has a central seam with buttons, and a white lace collar encircles the neckline. There are black ribbon details at the waist and on the sleeves. The drawing includes a second, less detailed outline of the dress from the back, rendered in simple pencil or ink without color or patterns, providing a structural view of the garment. The objects are arranged on a neutral, off-white background with no additional elements or embellishments.
title: Dress
